description: This file implements JSON parsing and loading functions for the 'cuttlefish' project, including functions to parse JSON strings and load JSON data from files using shared file descriptors.

methods.name: ParseJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string view into a Json::Value object.

methods.name: LoadFromFile (SharedFD)
methods.description: Loads and parses JSON data from an open shared file descriptor.

methods.name: LoadFromFile (std::string)
methods.description: Opens a file at the given path and loads JSON data from it.
